heading_redaction: Model-visible passages omit the leading '# Fictional scenario NNN' line because that number is the canonical document number.
agent_rule: The committed audit mapping is publicly readable. It is separate from the model-visible directory, and it is not access-controlled. Copying that directory outside the repository is a file copy, not an operating-system sandbox.

result_classes.synthetic_author_label_smoke: Local exact-match scores on author labels. Not a blinded semantic evaluation.
result_classes.ai_second_opinion: Annotations under benchmark/candidates/ai_second_opinion. Not human review and not an accuracy estimate.
result_classes.human_reviewed_development: The 30-case calibration packet has no recorded decisions.
result_classes.internal_label_blinded_test: The isolated export exists. No blinded model run has been scored.
result_classes.independent_external_test: Not available. This protocol does not create an external test set.
